title: Maximum Length of Repeated Subarray
summary: Given two integer arrays, nums1 and nums2, determine the longest subarray that is present in both arrays.
statement: Given two integer arrays, nums1 and nums2, determine the longest subarray that is present in both arrays.
constraints: Return the longest contiguous sequence appearing in both arrays.
hints: A matching pair extends the common suffix ending immediately before both positions.
Keep one DP row of common-suffix lengths.
On equality set next[j]=previous[j-1]+1; otherwise leave zero.
Every repeated subarray ends at a pair of equal elements, and the diagonal recurrence measures exactly its length.
editorial: Every repeated subarray ends at a pair of equal elements, and the diagonal recurrence measures exactly its length.
